scripts.build:win: npm run build:web && npm run backend:build && node scripts/verify-backend-binary.js --target=win && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:web && npm run backend:build && node scripts/verify-backend-binary.js --target=mac && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:web && npm run backend:build && node scripts/verify-backend-binary.js --target=linux && electron-builder --linux

scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run cap:web && cap sync ios
